title: VN Engine 2D
description:
VN Engine 2DNext-generation engine for 2D visual novels and interactive minigames. Tired of Ren'Py scripts? Want advanced cinematics without coding? VN Engine 2D combines a node-based editor with dual-track timeline editing to free you from code entirely.

Core Features• Visual node-based editor (zero scripting required)

• Dual-track timeline: dialogue progresses independently from animation

• Full Live2D integration: breathing / blinking / physics / mouse-follow auto

• Interactive timeline scrubbing: player input drives Live2D and video progression

• Asset library: backgrounds / character art / CGs / BGM / SFX / video / Live2D

• Real-time WYSIWYG preview

• Steam Achievements + Cloud Save integration (opt-in for exported games)

• Multilingual (Traditional Chinese / English / Japanese)

LicensingThis application is the "editor" (free). Commercial export and pro features unlock via DLC:

• Free (this application)[/b]: Full editor + preview

• Indie DLC: HTML5 / Windows export + commercial release

• Pro DLC: Indie features + Agent-assisted workflow automation + vnctl CLI agent

System Requirements•  Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)

•  4 GB RAM (8 GB recommended)

•  2 GB disk space

•  Internet (first-time license activation, then offline-capable)
description_short: 2D visual novel + minigame engine. Node-based editor + interactive timeline scrubbing, with Live2D . Free includes full editor and preview. Indie or Pro DLC unlocks export and commercial release.
